aboutText: I am Oumarou Billy, a Master’s student in Artificial Intelligence and a fullstack developer. I build complete applications from backend architecture to high-fidelity frontend interfaces, while continuously advancing my applied AI research. My goal is to build reliable, scalable, and impactful solutions aligned with modern tech demands.
